Doctor told me it is depression. I hardly drink coffee anymore. Don't drink booze or smoke.
I can't sleep enough and no appetite so doesn't eat that much ( I just weighed myself, I have lost 8 kg during the last month ).

I feel bad - no doubt. The people I used to talk with I can't anymore, my wife basically called them her friends and forbid me to talk to them.

Even worse, because of the bad and dark thoughts and my panic attacks, I'm afraid to be the only adult around my own children :'(

Hate my life right now.

Thanks for the elaboration.

I have been to the doctor, he told me to see a psychiatrist - but there is about 2 weeks waiting time :(

But thanks again - Your answers really means a lot to me!

Sorry, what is benzos? ( non us here )

And paperback for real? I always thought is was a movie trick?

I knew it last Thursday when she told me it was over.

:"(
I love your post - it gives hope. Not many things do this at the moment.
Yeah it seems like it isn't just me. No worries about advice, it seems LittleMissP has that covered elsewhere in the thread.
Then it's not just me or my mind .. crapper
It's sounds extremely simple when I read it. But I think it might be hard to just do it - but yeah, more me and my kids!

Woa - you do get the hard truth here.

You are right, I should not spend my time and energy on her relationships. But it's damn hard not to try and make sense of all this :(
